Title: Login with valid credentials
Steps:
1) Open login page
2) Enter valid email
3) Enter valid password
4) Click 'Log in'
Expected Result: User is logged in and redirected to dashboard

Title: Login with invalid password shows error
Steps:
1) Open login page
2) Enter valid email
3) Enter invalid password
4) Click 'Log in'
Expected Result: Error message is shown; user stays on login page

Title: Password field masks input
Steps:
1) Open login page
2) Type any password into password field

Title: Logout ends session
Steps:
1) Click profile menu
2) Click 'Logout'
3) Refresh the page
4) Try to open a protected URL
Expected Result: User is logged out; protected pages require login

Title: Search returns relevant results
Expected Result: Results page shows items relevant to the query
